# Frozen 1.6.0 outputs

These files contain synthetic inputs and outputs obtained by importing the unchanged, checksum-verified public 1.6.0 source archive outside the maintained Rust source tree. Each imported source file was compared byte-for-byte with Git commit `5202477edfe4b5d8bacfa5b2e9fd6eadd9624f7f`; `core-reference.json` records those source digests. The expected results come from the released implementation, rather than a second implementation of its algorithms.

`config-defaults.json` records all 49 settings. The 357 persisted-setting cases cover migrations, privacy choices, onboarding, provider settings, Unicode character bounds, numeric limits, malformed types and URLs. Accepted cases record the difference from the frozen defaults; rejected cases retain the reference's diagnostic for review. `xdg-paths.json` includes ordinary fallback and explicit empty roots. The 6,540 transcript cases cover command phrases, repeated corrections, sentence and paragraph boundaries, Unicode word boundaries, unusual whitespace and a deterministic synthetic corpus. The compiled `word-ranges.json` resource freezes Unicode 16 word classification observed through the reference runtime's regular-expression engine; transcript cases exercise both ends and neighboring characters of every range through the public normalization function.

`history-foundation.sql` is a synthetic database using the original eight-column schema; `released-data.sql` records its migration through the released stores, with source edits, rewrites and a screenshot attachment. `store-baseline.json` captures correction, continuation and merge results, Unicode and literal-wildcard searches, title guards, exact prompt text and a Markdown export. Runtime-generated merge timestamps alone are normalized. The 88 provenance cases cover provider/route combinations, context sources, Unicode model bounds and duration types/bounds. The 82 PNG cases cover truncated chunks, CRC corruption and image dimensions; the tiny image contains only two synthetic colored pixels. `store-reference.json` records source digests for these checks.

The Rust tests require only Cargo and these static JSON files. They do not import or execute Python. Reference collection is temporary development work; its Python script is excluded from the maintained source and final package.

`default-prompts.json` in the compiled resources preserves the eleven prompts, five Live templates and seven built-in styles as data. The prompt fixtures include 26 validation cases and ten damaged/valid override reads, including exact UTF-8 repair diagnostics. Sixteen title cases and a bounded request check label behavior without shortening stored source text. Five Scratchpad cases cover legacy defaults and malformed recovery documents. Their imported source digests are recorded in `prompt-reference.json`.
